# NIST Lennard-Jones fixture

`nist_lj_sample_4.txt` is an unchanged copy of configuration 4 from the NIST
[Lennard-Jones Fluid Reference Calculations: Cuboid Cell](https://www.nist.gov/mml/csd/chemical-informatics-group/lennard-jones-fluid-reference-calculations-cuboid-cell)
download archive (`ljsampleconfigurations-targz`). The NIST metadata defines the
file columns and reduced units. For the linear-force-shift potential at
`r_c = 3 sigma`, the page reports pair energy `-1.5001e1` and pair virial
`-4.3096e1` in reduced units.

NIST requests appropriate source credit. Its website states that unmarked NIST
information is public information that may be distributed or copied; the
general NIST data notice says employee-created work is not subject to US
copyright under 17 U.S.C. § 105, may be subject to foreign copyright, and is
provided as-is without warranty. This fixture is included with NIST attribution
and has not been modified.
